SUPERSEDED.why: the G14 design it pre-registers was replaced by the FP32 canonical gate (clauses C1/C2/C3 computed directly in fp32 from the trainable trunk onward).

g14_v2_preregistration.status: PROPOSED - awaiting user approval; NOT yet wired into the training path
g14_v2_preregistration.supersedes: G14 as implemented through commit 998be0c, whose binding clause required three-way argmax identity under BF16 evaluation
motivation: Grid point 3 halted on the BF16 G14 at pinned development row 3101 (brute 0, cached 1, batched 0).

The corrected shared-prefix characterization showed the disagreement was not confined to near-ties: under BF16 the brute force disagreed with the batched canonical on 33 of 177, 53 of 270 and 236 of 998 sampled rows for grid points 1, 2 and 3, including rows with margins at and above 0.1 nats, with top-2 perturbations up to 2.46e-01.
No margin-based tie criterion can absorb a 0.25-nat perturbation without declaring a large fraction of the development set unresolved, so a tie exemption was rejected.
The root cause is the BF16 forward path. Promoting the identical frozen weights to FP32 arithmetic reduces the three-way disagreement to zero and the score deltas to order 1e-05.

canonical_scorer.definition: the BATCHED R1 scorer, evaluated with the frozen language model in FP32, at the evaluation batch size of 128, on the fp32 evaluation path
canonical_scorer.certification_rule: the batched scorer is canonical ONLY while it reproduces the pinned brute-force reference exactly on the certification sample; certification is re-established whenever the model, tokenizer, answer cache, torch version or device changes
canonical_scorer.certification_result: 478 sampled rows across three frozen checkpoints, 0 brute-vs-canonical and 0 cached-vs-canonical argmax disagreements, exact argmax identity on every row including all 143 tight-margin rows
canonical_scorer.cached_scorer_status: an optimised inference implementation only; it must match the canonical argmax, and it never determines scientific checkpoint selection

model_identity.rule: FP32 evaluation promotes the EXACT frozen BF16 state values to FP32 computation; it never loads different higher-precision weights
model_identity.construction: load_frozen_causal_lm(pretrained=True) at the pinned revision in bfloat16, then .to(torch.float32)
model_identity.on_disk_dtype: BF16, all 272 tensors, so promotion is exact and lossless
proof_recorded: promoted state is bitwise identical to a direct FP32 load
promoted state round-trips back to BF16 exactly on every tensor
model_identity.provenance_caveat: state_dict_sha256 differs between dtypes (bf16 20add223..., fp32 d2f53e18...) because the hash covers serialised bytes; the VALUES are identical and both hashes must be recorded so this is never read as a different model

gate_definition.name: G14-v2
gate_definition.scope: at least 64 pinned development rows, drawn by the existing pinned_g14_rows rule, run BEFORE any checkpoint selection and again on the selected checkpoint
gate_definition.prefix_rule: one FP32 prefix tensor is computed per row and SHARED by all three scorers, so the gate isolates the scorer implementation and never confounds it with batch composition

clauses.requirement: batched (canonical) argmax == brute-force argmax on EVERY row
clauses.on_failure: HARD HALT with an atomic JSON record

clauses.requirement: cached argmax == canonical argmax on EVERY row
clauses.on_failure: HARD HALT with an atomic JSON record

clauses.requirement: R2 brute-force constrained walk == R2 cached walk on EVERY row
clauses.on_failure: HARD HALT with an atomic JSON record

gate_definition.no_exemption: there is NO margin-based exemption, NO tolerance band and NO near-tie category. Any argmax disagreement is a hard halt. This is stricter than the superseded gate, which carried an informational 1e-4 score tolerance.
gate_definition.score_deltas: recorded as DIAGNOSTICS ONLY: per-row max absolute deltas over the top-2 candidates and over all 100 candidates, plus the canonical top1-minus-top2 margin. No delta value can cause or prevent a halt.
recorded_per_row_on_halt: canonical, brute and cached scores for the top-2
pinned row index and its position in the pinned set
recorded_always: delta quantiles across the pinned set
the FP32 canonical certification reference and its result

fp32_scope_rule.statement: FP32 canonical evaluation governs EVERY evaluation that influences a scientific decision. BF16 must never select while FP32 only reports.
applies_to: per-epoch development evaluation driving early stopping
grid-point selection across the eight recipes
the final reported R1 scientific accuracy
all final E8B comparisons, including B3 versus B2 and any readout comparison
fp32_scope_rule.training_precision_unchanged: training remains BF16 autocast on the training path; only the evaluation path changes. The frozen language model is never trained, never fine-tuned and never modified.
fp32_scope_rule.bf16_reporting: BF16 evaluation figures may be reported ONLY as a secondary deployment or efficiency diagnostic, explicitly labelled as such, and never as a scientific accuracy or a selection basis.

measured_impact.note: the evaluation peak is far below the training peak of 5354 MiB reserved already measured, so the per-run memory gate is unaffected

tie_structure_under_fp32.finding: the BF16 near-tie cluster is largely a BF16 quantisation artefact rather than genuine model indecision
